NORML Starts NORML Hemp Alliance

(Marijuananews note: The message below was sent to approximately 400 hemp businesses, in response to repeated requests from hemp entrepreneurs who do not like the Me-No-Marijuana party line of the prohibitionist hemp associations. Whether or not hemp is marijuana, freedom is freedom. The truth is the truth. -- RC)

See
THE HEMP CASINO, HEMP WHORLED, & ROPERS VS. DOPERS
By John E. Dvorak, Hempologist
and

NORML supports the legalization of cannabis for adult recreational use, provision of medical marijuana to the seriously ill, and cultivation of hemp as an agricultural resource and viable consumer good.

You are invited to support the promotion of hemp by becoming a member of the NHA. This is an excellent opportunity to learn about industry developments in your area, keep up-to-date with hemp legislative initiatives, and network with others in the hemp industry. Members receive a weekly summary of cannabis legal developments from around the world, have access to hemp-related legal advice from the NORML Foundation legal department, and can instantly communicate with colleagues from the world of industrial hemp using NHA's online bulletin board.

The bulletin board is a valuable resource enabling members to ask questions, share

ideas, and meet other hemp business members (retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, growers, consultants) around North America.

In addition, members of the NHA will be listed on NORML's web page at www.norml.org with active links to your e-mail address and/or website.

The first six months trial-membership in the NHA is free. Please let us know if you wish to have your business listed on the NORML web page during this trial period.

If you decide to continue your membership with NHA, an annual fee of $25.00 will help support NORML's cannabis law reform efforts.

At any time if you wish to be removed from the NHA e-mail list, simply send a request to NHA Director Tom Dean (

NORML is determined to increase cannabis awareness through our support of the expanding hemp market. The NORML Hemp Alliance is a great way you can help your business grow while becoming active in cannabis law reform.

We look forward to working with you in the coming months.

Sincerely,

R. Keith Stroup, Esq.
NORML Founder,
Executive Director

John researches and writes about the past, present and future uses of cannabis hemp. He is the founder and proprietor of the Boston Hemp Co-op, Museum and Library. John was the Managing Editor of Hemp Magazine and has had articles published in Hempworld Magazine, the Journal of the International Hemp Association and Cannabis Canada (now Cannabis Culture). He is a member of the Hemp Industries Association, the International Hemp Association, and Mass Cann/NORML. He can be reached at boston.hemp@pobox.com and 781-662-4313.
